title: Robert Lewandowski and Chicago Fire's Clash with Inter Miami
seoTitle: Lewandowski and Chicago Fire's Clash with Inter Miami
subtitle: The Polish striker is in the spotlight after his transfer to Chicago Fire and the upcoming clash with Inter Miami
excerpt: Robert Lewandowski's transfer to Chicago Fire and the match against Inter Miami are generating significant media attention.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Polish striker Robert Lewandowski has transferred to Chicago Fire, generating major repercussions in Brazil, where he is followed by millions of fans. The club's match against Inter Miami, scheduled for September 10, 2026, is highly anticipated as both teams compete for the top spot in the Major League Soccer standings.

Lewandowski's Transfer to Chicago Fire

The player left his European club to play in the MLS, where his presence has already attracted international media attention. The decision to transfer to Chicago Fire was announced amid discussions regarding Lewandowski's absence from television broadcasts in Brazil, as Poland did not advance to the World Cup and he does not appear in national team matches.

Impact on Brazilian Broadcasts

Before his transfer, the clash between Lewandowski and Lionel Messi was watched by over 12 million viewers in the country. With his change of club and departure from the national team, the player's viewership in Brazil has dropped drastically, estimated at just 15,000 to 30,000 people on the night of the match against Inter Miami. No Brazilian television network is broadcasting the match live, requiring access to paid streaming platforms.

The Chicago Fire – Inter Miami Clash in 2026

The match, which will take place at Soldier Field, is highly relevant in the title race. Chicago Fire occupies third place with 38 points, while Inter Miami is in second with 43 points. With just a five-point difference between them, the clash is crucial for both teams' championship aspirations. Chicago Fire is currently on a five-game unbeaten run, while Inter Miami is experiencing more inconsistent form, with only one win in their last five matches.

Head-to-Head History

In their last five meetings, Inter Miami has won three times, drawn once, and lost only once, maintaining a statistical advantage in head-to-head encounters. However, Chicago Fire's psychological edge, having not suffered a defeat recently, could tip the scales in this match.

Match Expectations

Experts expect a tactical and demanding match, with Chicago Fire seeking to control the tempo and minimize defensive errors, while Inter Miami will look to exploit counter-attacking opportunities to break the deadlock. The result could define who leads the table and who will have the chance to vie for the MLS title.
